caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped box with a lid. The lid is primarily a pale beige color with light gray and muted tan organic patterns. The side of the lid features a vivid blue band adorned with darker blue and light blue swirling floral or leaf patterns. The body of the box below the lid is also decorated with blue and green swirling patterns, resembling stylized foliage or waves. In the center of the box's side is an oval-shaped panel filled with intricate, ornate patterns in shades of pink and cream. The background of the drawing is a solid, unadorned light beige color.
title: Toilette Box
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
